Trigger A creature within 30 feet that you can see is about to roll an attack roll, a saving throw, a skill check, or a Perception check.

Effect Choose one:

  • Guide — the triggering creature gains a +1 circumstance bonus to the roll.
  • Snarl — the triggering creature takes a −1 circumstance penalty to the roll. Snarl can only be applied to an attack roll, skill check, or Perception check, never a saving throw.

At 9th level (Surer Thread) the bonus and penalty increase to ±2.

Target the creatures, then use this from your sheet: you pick Guide or Snarl for each, and the GM's client arms it on them. It is spent by the first matching roll; your reaction goes then.
